Partition pseudotime states by density intersections

Source: R/density_intersection.R
density_points.Rd

Partition pseudotime states by density intersections

Usage

density_points(
  object = NULL,
  pseudotime_column = "pseudotime",
  group_column = NULL,
  meta_data = NULL,
  store = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  posterior_threshold = 0.8,
  n_grid = 512,
  n_boot = 50,
  bandwidth = "nrd0",
  plot = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object or a metadata data.frame.

pseudotime_column

Column name containing pseudotime values.

group_column

Optional metadata column containing ordered groups. When NULL, the function reuses celltype, seurat_clusters, cluster, or group when available.

meta_data

Deprecated alias of object for backwards compatibility.

store

Logical. When object is a Seurat object, store the partition result in object@tools.

overwrite

Logical. Overwrite an existing stored partition.

posterior_threshold

Maximum pairwise posterior dominance allowed inside a transition window. Lower values make transition windows narrower.

n_grid

Number of grid points used for kernel density evaluation.

n_boot

Number of bootstrap resamples used to assess boundary stability.

bandwidth

Bandwidth passed to stats::density().

plot

Logical. When TRUE, call plot_states() after computing the partition.

verbose

Logical.

Value

If object is a Seurat object, returns the updated object. Otherwise returns the partition result list.

Examples

test_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(cluster = "cluster1", pseudotime = rnorm(500, mean = 1, sd = 1)),
  data.frame(cluster = "cluster2", pseudotime = rnorm(500, mean = 2, sd = 1)),
  data.frame(cluster = "cluster3", pseudotime = rnorm(500, mean = 3, sd = 1))
)
density_points(test_data, pseudotime_column = "pseudotime", group_column = "cluster")
